initial_formula: Bulk soil IDs40..1039 only,not wall ghosts. H1=1m must equal maximum initial soil z+dp/2. M=K+4G/3,Mf=Kw/n,B=Mf/(M+Mf),d=max(H1-z,0),p0=rho_w*g*d,p=p0+B*(rho-rho_w)*g*d,sigma_zz=-(M/(M+Mf))*(rho-rho_w)*g*d,sigma_xx=sigma_yy=nu/(1-nu)*sigma_zz;offdiagonals0. Expected p/p0 and sigma_zz are float32 assignments;xx/yy multiply float32 k0 by float32 zz before conversion to binary64 state. Source float material constants and float global gravity are reproduced explicitly. Drained top ten p/p0 are0,but their nonzero initialized stress is retained and recorded,never zeroed to force agreement. Initial soil density is checked against configured rhop0 only at t=0,not fixed thereafter.

pore_dt_guard: Independently calculate dt_pore=PoreDtSafety*(rho_w*|g|/(Kw/n))*native_h^2/k using configured source-float parameters and actual uniform native h at every frame. Expected limit is about.476766us;coarse.4us and half.2us must not exceed it. FixedDt's signed dterror does not substitute for this separate pore diffusion limit. Pure selftest also rejects a synthetic.5us step;no tolerance relaxation.
